purpose: Expose the existing native turbine exhaust-gas temperature as read-only indexed telemetry, without changing engine dynamics.

source.scope: FGTurbine::bindmodel ties egt-degc to existing const GetEGT; documentation, direct C++ regression and wrapper version only. No EGT/thrust/fuel/phase formula changes.

observer.availability: Catalog-present read-only property and finite native value; zero or negative Celsius is valid.
observer.semanticLimit: Generic turbine gas-temperature estimate. Engine station is unspecified; it is not metal temperature or a calibrated F135/afterburner/nozzle-exit temperature.

nativeTemperatureObserver.scope: Actual const getter/property equality, index2, READ/notWRITE, rejected write, cold/reset Celsius, fuel-start heating before Running, idle/full dry power/augmentation, stopped cooldown and Trim retention.
nativeTemperatureObserver.failureHistory: Initial inline fixture destroyed externally owned engine before all pointer/function/thruster ties were removed; fixed fixture-only teardown to unbind while objects remain alive. Initial and debugger logs retained.

commands: node --test --test-concurrency=5 test/*.test.mjs (frozen SDK workspace and resolved native fixtures)
sdkBuildValidation.scope: One successful frozen-source build, locked toolchain, 5 compile jobs and 5 Node test workers.

toolchain.emscripten: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.9-git

failureHistory: Default Node 26.9.0 rejected before compile; successful build uses retained verified Node 26.8.2 binary.
Locked-node attempt reached link, but Homebrew Emscripten cache was outside writable roots; successful build reuses prior repo-contained 6.0.9 cache. No global cache writes or lock changes.

releasePacking.failureHistory: Default npm cache denied a write outside writable roots; final packing uses repo-contained cache.

installedF135TemperatureTrace.conditions: Real installed SDK, application engineControl, native hold-down, zero wind/airspeed, 1000 ft, dt 1/120; no timing/performance claims.

fullApplicationCi.expectedFailure: Existing F-35B stowed main-strut exterior-envelope case; not introduced by this thermal change.
fullApplicationCi.scope: Lint, tests, typecheck, production build and installed/emitted artifact verification; no GPU run.

findings.afterburnerTemperature: Matches the same native N2/TAT schedule as dry power; no additional AB heat is modeled.

preservation.previousArtifact: deps/felipegalind0-jsbsim-1.2.4-fork.11.tgz retained; all earlier immutable tarballs unchanged
preservation.aircraftData: No aircraft XML/data/manifest changes in this release; earlier below-fork10 rollbacks still require their matching aircraft data.

limitations: Run EGT follows TAT+363.1+(N2-IdleN2)/(MaxN2-IdleN2)*357.1. Augmentation has no additional temperature term.
Ordinary shutdown retains a hot native gas estimate and cools toward TAT at 7.3°C/s; this is an existing generic schedule, not a measured metal cooling curve.

Existing Start-to-Run schedule and stopped Trim-to-Off handover can jump temperature. Installed hot-stopped RunIC trace records the subsequent accepted-step drop of 610.7°C; observer release does not repair phase behavior.
No oil/ITT/metal observer is added, and turboprop/piston thermal properties are not assumed to belong to turbine engines.
No upstream submission/push or package publication; software contracts do not qualify aircraft thermal/optical fidelity.

primaryThermalContext.supports: Chapter10 EGT section: turbine exhaust-gas temperature is a gas measurement, distinct from metal temperature.
Engine stations place the afterburner downstream of turbine exit, not at a generic turbine gas sensor.
NASA TP1754 turbine-blade surface temperature is measured optically with background-radiation corrections.
Blackbody spectral radiance calibration uses Planck law; this does not calibrate a JSBSim gas proxy to F135 metal temperature.
